sentences.text: Gennady Gennadyevich Golovkin -LRB- Геннадий Геннадьевич Головкин born 8 April 1982 -RRB- is a Kazakhstani professional boxer who currently holds the unified WBA -LRB- Super -RRB- , WBC , IBF , and IBO middleweight titles .	professional boxer	professional boxer	WBC	World Boxing Council	IBF	International Boxing Federation	IBO	International Boxing Organization	middleweight	middleweight

As of May 2017 , he is ranked as the world 's best middleweight by BoxRec and the Transnational Boxing Rankings Board , and second best by The Ring .	middleweight	middleweight	BoxRec	BoxRec	Transnational Boxing Rankings Board	Transnational Boxing Rankings Board	The Ring	The Ring magazine Pound for Pound

He is also ranked as the world 's third best boxer , pound for pound , by The Ring , fifth by BoxRec , and seventh by the Transnational Boxing Rankings Board .	BoxRec	BoxRec	Transnational Boxing Rankings Board	Transnational Boxing Rankings Board	The Ring	The Ring magazine Pound for Pound	pound for pound	pound for pound

Golovkin won his first major world championship , the WBA interim middleweight title , by defeating Milton Núñez in 2010 .	middleweight	middleweight	interim	interim championship	Milton Núñez	Milton Núñez (boxer)

He was elevated to WBA -LRB- Regular -RRB- champion in the same year , and in 2011 would win the vacant IBO middleweight title by defeating Lajuan Simon .	IBO	International Boxing Organization	middleweight	middleweight	Lajuan Simon	Lajuan Simon
In 2014 , Golovkin was elevated to his current status of WBA -LRB- Super -RRB- champion and successfully defended both his titles against Daniel Geale .	Daniel Geale	Daniel Geale

Later that year he defeated Marco Antonio Rubio to add the WBC interim middleweight title to his collection , and defeated David Lemieux in 2015 to win the IBF middleweight title . After Canelo Álvarez vacated his WBC middleweight title in 2016 , Golovkin was elevated to full champion and now holds world titles by three of the four major boxing sanctioning bodies .	WBC	World Boxing Council	middleweight	middleweight	Canelo Álvarez	Canelo Álvarez
A calculating pressure fighter , Golovkin is known for his powerful and precise punching , balance , and methodical movement .	pressure fighter	pressure fighter

With a streak of 23 knockouts that spanned from 22 November 2008 to 18 March 2017 , he holds the highest knockout percentage -- 89.8 % -- in middleweight championship history .	middleweight	middleweight	knockout	knockout
